name: Acuity Scheduling
description: Acuity Scheduling is an online appointment-booking platform for businesses that manage calendars, availability, intake forms, payments, packages, and client appointments. Teams use it to let customers self-schedule services while keeping booking operations and client records organized.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Acuity Scheduling account, then choose which agents can read or manage its authorized scheduling data under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read scheduling data
capabilities.description: Read appointments, availability, clients, calendars, appointment types, forms, products, orders, webhooks, and account metadata.

capabilities.label: Manage scheduling
capabilities.description: Book, update, reschedule, cancel, or mark appointments as no-shows; create or remove blocked time; update clients; and manage webhooks.

allowed.label: Read Acuity Scheduling
allowed.description: Read bounded authorized Acuity Scheduling data.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Acuity Scheduling
approvalRequired.description: Change appointments, blocked time, clients, or webhooks.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: OAuth credentials never enter agent-visible requests or results.

blocked.label: Use another API origin
blocked.description: Every request stays on Acuity Scheduling's documented API origin.

blocked.label: Call another endpoint
blocked.description: Relay permits only Acuity Scheduling's documented public API routes.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded transfer
blocked.description: Relay bounds queries, request bodies, responses, redirects, nesting, and execution time.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Reads run directly. Every appointment, blocked-time, client, or webhook change requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected operation authorized by the connected Acuity Scheduling account runs without Relay per-action approval. Provider authority, exact routes, bounds, credential protection, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts account-bound Acuity Scheduling REST tools and attaches OAuth credentials server-side.
Relay mounts account-bound Acuity Scheduling REST tools and attaches OAuth credentials server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's Acuity Scheduling OAuth application and production client credentials are not configured yet.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register the Relay Console OAuth client at Acuity Scheduling, set https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/acuity-scheduling/callback, store ACUITY_SCHEDULING_CLIENT_ID and ACUITY_SCHEDULING_CLIENT_SECRET in Railway, deploy, and run live connect, read, Safe approval, Dangerous mutation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial checks.

evidence.supports: Acuity documents its OAuth authorization-code flow for multi-account applications, api-v1 scope, exact authorization and token endpoints, GET /api/v1/me, and upstream disconnect endpoint.
Acuity documents appointments, availability, calendars, forms, clients, blocked time, certificates, products, orders, and webhooks under its public API v1 origin.
Acuity documents dynamic webhooks for appointment and order events and a limit of 25 registered webhooks.
Acuity documents API validation errors and limits of 10 requests per second and 20 concurrent connections per IP.
